correctness.rationale: The block-gradient recursion and mean/disagreement formulas are valid; independently replayed six rounds with rational 1D heterogeneous clients and verified these identities. But the claimed equalities ||alpha(H+alpha I)^(-1)||=alpha/(alpha+mu) and ||H(H+alpha I)^(-1)||=L/(L+alpha) are FALSE when mu,L are merely non-tight bounds, as the stated assumptions allow. Take H=[2], mu=1,L=3,alpha=2: both true norms equal 1/2, while the claimed values are 2/3 and 3/5. The claimed unique optimum alpha=sqrt(3) for this H is also false; the true joint norm maximum is minimized at alpha=2 with value 1/2. Requiring mu=lambda_min(H),L=lambda_max(H), or expressly redefining factors as uniform class upper envelopes, would correct this, but is not the current theorem. No complete changed scientific files were supplied, so the false final claim cannot be passed or called repaired.
